author: kxfx
text:
Hi there Naascott,

Great charting. However, why did you look at the lower DP for entry (where you placed a text "Sell"), instead of the higher one with Mini QM? I thought QM is a good trap and great for entry at the QM Level. Let me guess, is it because there is no engulf of the FL (the FL is still not broken in mini QM pattern)?

Also, what is key level as per your knowledge? is it the obvious high/low of higher timeframe?

author: naascott
text: Hey there, Kx. Thanks for stopping in. QM's yes, are good places. But for me on this particular exercise, it was neat seeing price come back to the sources of the engulfs. Key levels, I suppose, can be a bit subjective. Clearly, HTF S/R's are, FTR's FL's, old QM levels, etc.
